page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.16xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture, driven by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource allocation ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This instance type does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps to support high-throughput network operations. The lack of integrated local storage and a relatively low memory-to-core ratio of 1:2 represent key architectural tradeoffs, prioritizing raw processing capacity over massive memory footprints or local disk performance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high compute density make this instance suitable for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory allocations. It is designed for tasks such as high-performance web serving, batch processing, distributed analytics, and compute-heavy application servers.
